MISSING_TERMS:
- Explicit waiver of delivery of Compliance Certificates for: Q1 (June 30, 2020), Q2 (September 30, 2020), Q3 (December 31, 2020), Q4 (March 31, 2021), and the Operating Year ending March 31, 2021; plus waiver of the Annual Business Plan (Operating Year ending March 31, 2020), each through the Extended Waiver Period.

{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo says the waiver 'suspends ... reporting obligations' while also requiring weekly liquidity reporting/enhanced monitoring (Key Deal Terms and Strengths).", "It claims financial covenant compliance is suspended, yet simultaneously imposes a 'Minimum Liquidity of $15,000,000 at all times' (an active financial covenant).", "It calls the instrument a 'Fifth Amended and Restated Limited Waiver' but also states the waiver 'amends and restates the original credit agreement,' which is inconsistent (limited waiver vs amendment-and-restatement of the Credit Agreement)."]}
